newsitem.title: USA: Science to acquire Innovative Comm.
newsitem.headline: Science to acquire Innovative Comm.

text.p: Science Dynamics Corp said on Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets and intellectual property of Innovative Communications Technology Limited for 1.5 million shares of the company's stock.
Innovative Communications is a corporation in the Channel islands which is principally engaged in digital communications.

Upon closing the transaction Innovative majority stockholder and president Alan Bashforth will succeed Lyndon Keele as president of Science Dynamics and Keele will continue as chairman of the board of the company.
